examples.trans: We need to do everything and is recovering on time.

meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'здороветь'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will recover'.

meanings.note: Question word. Core Russian adv meaning 'how; as' in everyday speech.

meanings.note: Perfective of падать. Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'пасть'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to fall, to drop', paired with 'падать'.
